title.narrative: Support for the Rehabilitation and Construction of Health Infrastructure in Central African Republic

description.narrative: UNOPS was requested by the French Red Cross to provide support for the rehabilitation and construction of health infrastructure in different regions of Central African Republic, notably in Bangui, Berberati, Bangassou, Bria, Bouar, Kemo, and others. By supporting this project, UNOPS will contribute to the efforts of the Central African Government in the fight against HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis and the Covid-19 response, as well as to the more general improvement and strengthening of the health system in Central African Republic.
